cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 11th Nov 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 11th Nov 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

dorms.name: Deluxe 4 Bed Mixed Dorm Ensuite
dorms.description: Dormitory style and range in size from 2 beds upwards.  They offer mixed accommodation.
dorms.labelDescription:
4 Bed Privacy Share + Ensuite to yourselves is the ultimate space for that single traveller, a couple of friends or group of 4.  

A/C and equipped with double power point, bed light, your own personal shelf and a secure locker unit.

paymentProcedure.description:
Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.

privates.name: Standard Double Bed Private Shared Bathroom
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription: Our first floor Private King + Shared Ensuite is a super comfy King bed splits to twin single. There is a sliding door out to the covered walkway and the ensuite is shared with the Private Queen.  Perfect for a minimum 1 night stay. Advise if twin setup.
